Online Tax Forfeit Parcel Auction is Live
Wright County News
Posted on September 22, 2026
The Wright County tax forfeiture auctions are now live. Parcels are available to be bid on via our online auction host, Public Surplus. The auction will end at 9 p.m. CDT Sunday, Sept. 27. All relevant parcel information is located within the item listing. If you have any questions, please reach out to Taxpayer Services at Wright County. The link to the online auction is below: Public Surplus - Wright County Tax Forfeiture Auction
